market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78,500 today. Reaching $45,000 requires a ~43% drawdown sometime before Dec 31, 2026 (~8 months). Such drawdowns occur in BTC roughly 20-25% of any 8-month windows historically, but current cycle position (post-halving, recent weakness from highs) makes a deep capitulation possible though not base-case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock magnitude over 8 months; whether cycle low has already been seen.
